name: Koninklijke Heijmans N.V.
summary: Koninklijke Heijmans N.V. engages in the real estate, construction, and infrastructure businesses in the Netherlands and internationally. It focuses on the development of large and smaller-scale projects in urban and out-of-town areas, as well as acts as an initiator, developer, and seller of residential properties. The company is also involved in building homes; and the restoration, redevelopment, renovation, maintenance, and service of existing housing stock.
